findings.lesson: When history shows sibling trajectories that each kept a win from a common parent, the un-merged win is cheap, high-probability EV: recover the artifact, prove dispatch-disjointness of the changed regions, port host-only, and expect the sibling's measured delta to reproduce within ~0.1% under same-draw ABBA.
findings.observation: Merging ep4-tr1's kept unified sub-wave split rule into the retained v9 lineage yielded +0.7286% overall geomean on same-draw ABBA (B<A on both repeats; decode band -2..-19% per shape) and a 224.149us nomination evaluate (90/90, correct=true), reproducing tr1's original +0.735% on the shared parent almost exactly, with an identical correctness fingerprint (max_abs 2^-9, max_rel 2^-7).
findings.resolution: Fix kept: the merged tree is the nominee (work/kernel/kernel.py byte-exact = artifact sha256:42e5c7e0..., evaluate gtrial_10a358de).
findings.root_cause: v9's batch-tiered pps floors over-split low-batch decode shapes (extra partial traffic + fa_combine fan-in + kernel prologues in the latency-starved sub-wave regime); tr1's unified floor rule s_fill = sm // base_ctas removes the over-splitting, and the change is dispatch-disjoint from v9's ws gate (base_ctas <= 55 => tiles <= 27 < 64), so the two epoch-4 wins compose without interaction.

findings.lesson: In latency-bound reduction epilogues, price narrow-dtype partial formats by conversion instructions per CTA, not saved bytes; a pre-registered dev-probe gate (bitwise guards + interleaved CUPTI cohort geomean) catches this for one dev job instead of an ABBA+evaluate pair. Split-KV partial precision is now closed for this family (bf16 analytic + fp16 measured refutations).
findings.observation: fp16 po partials with producer-side 2^-4 pre-scaling (po AND pl; merge math bit-for-bit unchanged) passed every correctness gate -- 4 splits==1 guards bitwise-identical, 7 split cases within tolerance vs a naive fp32 reference, 55-splits/39-dead NaN-safe -- but ran the decode cohort at 1.0235x the fp32-partials tree against a pre-registered <=0.97 gate, with +12.31%/+6.22% regressions on the 55-split small-rows shapes and gains (-0.9..-1.4%) only at >=256 rows.
findings.resolution: Rolled back: D1 kept tree restored byte-exact (cmp + sha256 4fdc2243..., zero D2 markers); rejection recorded restore_before; no ABBA spent (dev gate failed first).
findings.root_cause: Per-half cvt.f32.f16 widening issue cost in fa_combine dominates when the combine grid has only 2-4 CTAs (rows/8): ~544 extra widen instructions/thread with no parallelism to hide them (+1.2-1.8us on a ~14us kernel) exceed the halved po load-traffic saving (<0.5us); at >=32 CTAs the cost spreads and traffic wins. The epoch-4 analytic EV priced bytes only, and D1's deeper sub-wave splits (up to 55) amplified exactly this per-element combine cost.

hypothesis: Two-branch hypothesis for epoch-5 att-1 on the retained v9 dual-kernel flash_attention tree: (H1) the epoch-4 sibling trajectory's kept sub-wave split re-tune (unified rule s_fill = sm // base_ctas; splits = min(pages_est, s_fill)) is gate-disjoint from v9's warp-specialized dispatch and merges host-only for ~+0.7% overall geomean; (H2) halving split-KV partial traffic via fp16 po partials with producer-side 2^-4 pre-scaling of po AND pl (keeping fa_combine merge math bit-for-bit unchanged) cuts decode-cohort device time >=3% and overall geomean >=+0.5% with correctness margins within class. H1 CONFIRMED-MEASURED (+0.7286% ABBA, B<A both repeats). H2 REFUTED-MEASURED (decode cohort 1.0235x SLOWER than the <=0.97 gate; correctness passed everywhere) and reverted.

profile_evidence.evidence_chain: Deep+counters profile (gtrial_08a6df44) established the heavy band is tensor-issue bound at its structural ceiling (tensor max pipe 67.73%, wait+barrier stalls, 1 CTA/SM, 0 spills) -> no device-side heavy-band lever exists, so epoch-5 EV concentrated in host dispatch + the latency-starved decode band -> D1 merged the disjoint kept sub-wave re-tune and ABBA/evaluate confirmed +0.7286%/224.149us -> the decode band's prior SOL latency-starvation motivated D2 (halve partial bytes); the D2 dev probe localized the failure to fa_combine widen-instruction issue cost at 2-4 CTAs (per-shape ratio pattern: worst at 55 splits/few rows, negative only at >=256 rows) -> rejected and restored. Host-side observation throughout: guards bitwise-identical and heavy-shape timings unchanged prove neither D1 nor D2 touched the profiled heavy-band code path.
